CustomField.description: Based on Annualised Deal Value of QFF and QBR Return either Low,Medium or High
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Qantas Frequent Flyer'), IF(Amount>=0 && Amount<2000000, 'Low', IF(Amount>=2000000 && Amount<5000000,'Medium', IF(Amount>=5000000 ,'High',''))), IF(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Qantas Business Rewards'), IF(Amount>=0 && Amount<400000, 'Low', IF(Amount>=400000 && Amount<1000000,'Medium', IF(Amount>=1000000 ,'High',''))),''))
CustomField.label: Partner Value
